title: 우편환법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:29:0:00034:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 29 (Procedure for Issuing Online Remittances)
(1) Any person requesting the issuance of an online remittance must submit an online remittance application to the post office. <Amended July 31, 1998>
(2) When a person requesting the issuance of an online remittance, as specified in paragraph (1), desires to request one of the following items, they must indicate this on the "special handling" section of the online remittance application:
    1. A payment order as stipulated in Article 6(1) of the Act
    2. Retention of an online remittance certificate as stipulated in Article 30
    3. Delivery of a condolence message as stipulated in Article 32
    4. Issuance of an online remittance as stipulated in Article 33
    5. Deleted <July 8, 2016>
(3) Any person requesting one of the items specified in paragraph (2) must pay the fee as determined and announced by the Minister of the Ministry of Science and Technology Information and Communication. <Amended July 31, 1998, March 3, 2008, March 24, 2013, July 26, 2017>
